research_rationale: Read ORIGINAL:EO:13168 in full, all TERM:EO:13168 records, ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13225 and the located actor provisions. All original establishment, reporting, information, hearings, support, travel and FACA commands are Commission-dependent. Section 6 gives a final-report-plus-30-day trigger, not simply a fixed two-year life; the 2002-09-22 outer limit occurs after the confirmed 2001 formal revocation. Section 4 deadlines do not prove submission or termination. EO:13225 section 3(d) revokes this order among committees already terminated and whose work is completed; its section 5 expressly fixes effectiveness at 2001-09-30, not signing on 2001-09-28. A report or other held dated trigger fact is required before assigning earliest cessation. The dossier holds no extension or dated submission evidence, and has no listed conflicts; machine missing=[] does not cure this actual gap. Original is fr_originals_high, acceptable_as_original true, requires_page_check false; no page inspection is asserted. The bounded machine searches were read, but cannot supply this event fact.
unresolved_material_gaps: The dossier does not hold the actual final-report submission date for the Commission. Section 6 terminates it 30 days after submission (subject to the stated outer limit and possible Presidential extension). EO:13225 section 3 says it had already terminated before the 2001-09-30 revocation. The six-month reporting deadline and two-year outer limit cannot establish that earlier actual termination date.
